title: The Price of a Period Billed in Advance on a ShieldCare Plan
content:
A period billed in advance with a premium invoice on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan is priced from
the plan's own premium history: whether the instalment most recently billed differs from the plan's
monthly premium, and whether a statement has closed on the store credit account inside the last 3 months.

| What the records show | The price of a period billed in advance |
| --- | --- |
| the instalment most recently billed differs from the plan's monthly premium, and a statement has closed on the store credit account inside the last 3 months | priced at the instalment most recently billed on the plan |
| that instalment differs from the plan's monthly premium, and no statement has closed on that account inside the last 3 months | priced at the average of the instalments billed on the plan inside the last 3 months |
| every other plan | priced at the plan's monthly premium |

The average of the instalments billed inside the last 3 months is the total of those instalments divided by
the number of them, taken to the cent; where no instalment stands inside those 3 months the divisor is
taken as 1.

### Points of judgement

Where the instalment most recently billed is the same figure as the plan's monthly premium, neither of the
first two rows is reached and the period in advance is priced at the plan's monthly premium. Only a
difference between the two opens the schedule, and the statement history of the account then decides
between the most recent instalment and the average of the quarter.

### A case on hypothetical figures

Take a plan whose monthly premium is 14.99. Where the instalment most recently billed is also 14.99, a period
in advance is priced at 14.99, whatever the account's statement history. Where instead the instalments billed
inside the last 3 months are 16.12, 15.74 and 17.03, the 17.03 being the most recent: with a statement closed
on the account inside those 3 months a period in advance is priced at 17.03, and with no statement closed
inside them it is priced at the average of the three, 16.30.
